checks.title: events in the host's order under block list's heading per day («Сегодня» with the date beside it in sf-time), each day an ordered list named by its heading; an event without an id or a title, or a repeated id, is left out
checks.covers: settings.items, settings.group, settings.heading-level, accessibility.role list, relations group-heading cl-time

steps.check: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('#order'); const groups = [...el.querySelectorAll('.sf-list-timeline-group')]; const heads = groups.map((g) => g.querySelector('.sf-list-timeline-day')); const date = heads[0].querySelector('sf-time.sf-group-heading-date time'); const log = [...document.querySelectorAll('#log .sf-list-timeline-item')].map((li) => li.dataset.id).join(','); return groups.length === 2 && heads.every((h) => h.classList.contains('sf-group-heading')) && heads[0].textContent.trim().startsWith('Сегодня') && heads[1].textContent.trim().startsWith('Вчера') && date && date.textContent === '9 ноября' && heads[0].getAttribute('role') === 'heading' && heads[0].getAttribute('aria-level') === '3' && groups[0].querySelector('ol').getAttribute('aria-labelledby') === heads[0].id && log === 'backup,update,cert'; })()

checks.title: the marker is .sf-featured-icon toned by status (error the error tone), the kind's glyph when the event names none (comment chat_bubble, sms phone_iphone), a dot with no icon; the status said in words
checks.covers: settings.items status icon kind, relations featured-icon

steps.check: (() => { const m = (id) => document.querySelector(`#order [data-id=${id}] .sf-list-timeline-rail .sf-featured-icon`); return m('comment').classList.contains('sf-featured-icon--neutral') && m('comment').textContent.trim() === 'chat_bubble' && m('sms').textContent.trim() === 'phone_iphone' && m('charge').classList.contains('sf-featured-icon--error') && m('paid').classList.contains('sf-featured-icon--success') && document.querySelector('#order [data-id=charge] .sr-only').textContent === 'Ошибка: ' && document.querySelector('#log [data-id=cert] .sf-list-timeline-dot') !== null && document.querySelector('#order [data-id=status] .sf-list-timeline-rail').getAttribute('aria-hidden') === 'true'; })()

checks.title: the actor is sf-avatar line (a picture) and a bold name at the start of the sentence; a system actor is the name only; a string actor still reads as a name

steps.check: (() => { const head = (id) => document.querySelector(`#order [data-id=${id}] .sf-list-timeline-head`); const avatar = head('status').querySelector('sf-avatar'); return avatar && avatar.getAttribute('aria-hidden') === 'true' && avatar.getAttribute('line') === '1' && avatar.getAttribute('hue') === 'teal' && head('status').querySelector('b.sf-list-timeline-actor').textContent === 'Анна Котова' && !head('sms').querySelector('sf-avatar') && head('sms').querySelector('b').textContent === 'Робот' && document.querySelector('#log [data-id=backup] b.sf-list-timeline-actor').textContent === 'Планировщик'; })()

checks.title: a field change is sf-change inline in the sentence: the old value quiet, the new one in the text colour, no badge

steps.check: (() => { const change = document.querySelector('#order [data-id=status] .sf-list-timeline-head sf-change'); const after = change && change.querySelector('.sf-change__after'); return Boolean(after) && after.textContent === 'Передан в доставку' && change.querySelector('.sf-change__before').textContent === 'Собран' && !change.querySelector('.sf-badge, s, del'); })()

checks.title: one quiet meta line «sf-time · text» (the time under a day heading), the comment's text in an outline with no fill
checks.covers: settings.time-format, settings.now, settings.items kind comment, relations cl-time

steps.check: (() => { const meta = document.querySelector('#order [data-id=sms] .sf-list-timeline-meta'); const time = meta.querySelector('sf-time time'); const com = document.querySelector('#order [data-id=comment] .sf-list-timeline-comment'); const cs = getComputedStyle(com); const rel = document.querySelector('#log [data-id=backup] sf-time time'); return time.textContent === '14:30' && time.getAttribute('datetime') === '2026-11-09T11:30:00.000Z' && meta.textContent.includes(' · ') && meta.textContent.includes('Заказ 48 215') && com.textContent.startsWith('Клиент просит') && cs.borderTopStyle === 'solid' && (cs.backgroundColor === 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)' || cs.backgroundColor === 'transparent') && !document.querySelector('#order [data-id=comment] .sf-list-timeline-meta').textContent.includes('Клиент') && rel.textContent === '2 минуты назад'; })()

checks.title: a run of one actor and kind longer than collapse folds into «Ещё N изменений»; its press reveals it in place, moves the focus to the first revealed event and says expand

steps.check: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('#order'); const run = el.querySelector('.sf-list-timeline-run'); return run && run.querySelector('.sf-list-timeline-run-text').textContent.trim() === 'Ещё 6 изменений' && run.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'false' && !el.querySelector('[data-id=edit-1]'); })()

(() => { const el = document.querySelector('#order'); return !el.querySelector('.sf-list-timeline-run') && el.querySelectorAll('[data-id^=edit-]').length === 6 && document.activeElement === el.querySelector('[data-id=edit-1]'); })()

checks.title: state draws steps: the current one aria-current=step, each step said in words, the line after the current one dashed

steps.check: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('#steps'); const cur = el.querySelector('[aria-current=step]'); return cur && cur.dataset.id === 's4' && cur.querySelector('.sr-only').textContent === 'Сейчас: ' && el.querySelector('[data-id=s1] .sr-only').textContent === 'Пройдено: ' && el.querySelector('[data-id=s5] .sr-only').textContent === 'Впереди: ' && getComputedStyle(cur, '::before').borderInlineStartStyle === 'dashed' && el.querySelector('[data-id=s1] .sf-featured-icon').classList.contains('sf-featured-icon--solid'); })()

checks.title: --sf-space-3 between events and 0 inside one; the connector from one event's first line to the next one's; the last event of a day has none; the list paints no surface

steps.check: (() => { const items = [...document.querySelectorAll('#log .sf-list-timeline-group:first-child .sf-list-timeline-item')]; const line = getComputedStyle(items[0], '::before'); const last = getComputedStyle(items[1], '::before'); const space = ((value) => { const probe = document.createElement('div'); probe.style.paddingBlockEnd = value; document.body.append(probe); const px = getComputedStyle(probe).paddingBlockEnd; probe.remove(); return px; })('var(--sf-space-3)'); const a = items[0].querySelector('.sf-list-timeline-rail').getBoundingClientRect(); const b = items[1].querySelector('.sf-list-timeline-rail').getBoundingClientRect(); const top = items[0].getBoundingClientRect().top + parseFloat(line.top); const bottom = items[0].getBoundingClientRect().bottom - parseFloat(line.bottom); const root = getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('#order .sf-list-timeline')); return getComputedStyle(items[0]).paddingBottom === space && line.content !== 'none' && last.content === 'none' && Math.abs(top - (a.top + a.height / 2)) < 0.5 && Math.abs(bottom - (b.top + b.height / 2)) < 0.5 && root.backgroundColor === 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)'; })()

checks.title: a title with href is a link; its press asks sf-list-timeline-navigate, cancelable
has-more draws «Показать ещё»; its press asks load-more {direction after, after: the last id}; loading makes it busy

steps.check: (() => { const el = document.querySelector('#log'); return el.getAttribute('data-loading') === 'true' && el.querySelector('.sf-list-timeline-more sf-button').hasAttribute('loading') && el.querySelector('.sf-list-timeline-more button').textContent.includes('Загружаем'); })()

checks.title: density is the page's: the deprecated density=compact writes data-sf-density on the root and is noted in SF.deprecations

steps.check: (() => { const root = document.querySelector('#dense .sf-list-timeline'); return root.getAttribute('data-sf-density') === 'compact' && SF.deprecations.list().some((note) => note.component === 'sf-list-timeline' && note.from === 'density') && !document.querySelector('#order .sf-list-timeline').hasAttribute('data-sf-density'); })()

checks.title: with no events one quiet line; new events draw the list

steps.check: (() => { const none = document.querySelector('#none'); return none.getAttribute('data-empty') === 'true' && none.querySelector('.sf-list-timeline-quiet').textContent === 'Событий пока нет' && !none.querySelector('ol'); })()
